summary: The child has been learning to cope with their stuttering by writing a letter to their stutter and making friends who also stutter. They have had a stutter since they were around five years old and have been attending speech therapy since they were three. The child has had some positive experiences with speaking in front of a group, such as giving a presentation about Babe Ruth in third grade, and has found that one-on-one interactions and taking their time when speaking can be helpful.
